controls: explicit same-parent B/x indices and distinct C values
nonzero output/input offsets, full row padding and last active addresses
both inputs prevalidated even when counterpart is zero
changed last-row causality and immutable physical inputs
wrong offsets/strides, negative/bool/overflow/count and exact minus-one extents
read/read alias permitted; output/input/status aliases reject

math.main: Prevalidate all active finite Half inputs, exact FP32 multiply then one RNE finite Half store; no clamp/FMA/intermediate Half, no generic FTZ
math.signed_zero: Exact witness and raw operand hashes preserve sign; general numeric comparison may equate signed zeros; no subnormal flushing
math.wide: Same finite Half operands, one exact FP64 product then RNE finite Half; all finite Half products are exact FP32 because <=22 significand bits and exponent range safely within FP32

policy.exact_witnesses: additional required fixed words; MAIN/WIDE equality is a source self-check

scope: Borrowed standalone Half product used separately for B*x and C*z; no activation/projection/graph/state publication

shape.alias: Read/read same physical parent allowed; output disjoint from both inputs/status; status disjoint from inputs too
shape.input_view_extent: offset+(rows-1)*stride+width+7, checked UInt32 address and host size arithmetic
shape.output_owner_extent: output_offset+rows*output_stride+7, checked; prefix and every row tail remain canaries
shape.parent: One physical [T,3H] B/C/x owner, no separate B/x copies; C*z has one additional padded z owner
